parsed.name: retail_attention_contrarian_flow
parsed.strategy: I fade the retail-attention crowd: the WSB/ApeWisdom/AltIndex lists are dominated by GME, MU, ORCL, RKLB, NBIS, BB, SNDK and the BYND/DNUT/GPRO meme cluster, none of which I own. Instead I buy the names where analyst revision flow is strongly positive (MRK +22, AMGN +26, ABBV +20, ARGX +17, AME +12 net raises) while headline counts and retail-tracker presence are near zero - the flow knows something the crowd has not noticed. Biotech PDUFA dates give dated catalysts; semis and power-grid give the AI-capex leg. I would be wrong if the quiet names start appearing on ApeWisdom (crowding arrives), if net raises turn negative, or if a CRL or capex cut hits before the flow can be validated.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY net of costs by owning positive analyst-revision-flow names that retail attention trackers have not yet crowded into.
